definitions.explanation: A track and field event in which athletes jump over a horizontal bar without any aids.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}り{高跳|たかと}び⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: She won a gold medal in high jump.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}り{高跳|たかと}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世界記録|せかいきろく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧だ。
examples.english: The world record in high jump is over 2 meters.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{走|はし}り{高跳|たかと}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧きた。
examples.english: I have been practicing high jump since I was a child.

notes:
{走|はし}り{高跳|たかと}び is often shortened to {高跳|たかと}び. Modern high jumpers typically use the "Fosbury Flop" technique, going over the bar backward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走|はし}り{高跳|たかと}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (high jumper)
- ⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧ (to clear the bar)
- ⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧ (to take off)

TECHNIQUES:
- {背面跳|はいめんと}び (Fosbury Flop, lit. "back jump")
- ⟦{挟|はさ}み→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧{跳|と}び (scissors jump, older technique)
